title: Kestrel 7-Day Return — Eligibility Terms for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**The right.** The Kestrel 7-Day Return lets the buyer under Vehicle Purchase Agreements return the vehicle for a refund or, when the program allows exchanges, apply the purchase to another Kestrel vehicle. A return opens when the buyer e-signs the 7-day return authorization; the order then shows return pending.

**Window.** The return is requested no later than the last day of the return window counted from the handover date. The window is counted in calendar days with the handover date as day 0 and ends at the end of the last day of the program's return window days; a request on that last day qualifies and a request the next day does not. The handover date is taken from the order record.

**Mileage.** Miles driven are the odometer the customer reports at the request less the handover odometer recorded on the order. When they exceed the program's return mileage hard cap the return is not accepted, and when they exceed the program's return mileage allowance the return is accepted with an excess-mileage fee.

**Exchange chain.** Returns used across the exchange chain must be below the program's returns per exchange chain. The exchange chain of an order is the order itself, the order it replaced in an exchange, and so on back to the original order; returns used are the orders in that chain whose status is returned. An exchange replacement order whose chain has already used its return carries no 7-day right.

**One request per order.** Only one return request may be made per order, whatever became of it — whether it is awaiting the customer's confirmation, confirmed, withdrawn or completed.

**Handback.** The vehicle must be handed back within the program's return handback days after the request date, by home pickup or, when allowed, hub drop-off.

**No extension.** The return right is not extended by registration delays, repairs or reschedules.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, 7-day window, handover on day 0).**

| Request day | Qualifies |
|---|---|
| day 7 | yes |
| day 8 | no |

**Mileage cases (hypothetical, Kestrel Certified: allowance 400, hard cap 600; handover odometer 22000).**

| Odometer reported | Miles driven | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 22380 | 380 | accepted, no excess-mileage fee |
| 22600 | 600 | accepted with an excess-mileage fee (above 400, not above 600) |
| 22601 | 601 | not accepted |

**Hypothetical chain case.** A buyer returned a Kestrel Inspected vehicle as an exchange, and the original order is now returned. The replacement order's chain has used its one return, so the replacement carries no 7-day right.
